input.quote: THE LICENSED TECHNOLOGY IS PROVIDED ON AN "AS IS" BASIS WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND AND LICENSOR HEREBY
input.rationale: Article VIX is a pure disclaimer: the Licensed Technology is provided "AS IS" with all express and implied warranties disclaimed, and Licensor expressly does not warrant error-free operation, conformity to documentation, or that nonconformities will be corrected. No affirmative performance warranty, warranty period, or remedy appears anywhere in the Agreement (the only other "warrants" language is Licensee-side or mutual boilerplate about counsel). This is the playbook walk-away position, so we insert an express warranty (professional and workmanlike services; 12-month software / 90-day services conformance to documentation; compliance with laws; no malicious code) with a repair, replacement or refund remedy, and carve that express warranty out of the disclaimer so it is not swallowed.

proposal.summary: Add an affirmative performance/conformance warranty with repair-replace-refund remedy and carve it out of the AS IS disclaimer.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article VIX currently leaves the Licensed Technology entirely "AS IS" with no affirmative warranty, so we added a workmanlike-performance and documentation-conformance warranty (12 months software / 90 days services) with a repair, replacement or refund remedy, and carved it out of the disclaimer. If helpful, we can fall back to 90 days for software and 30 days for services with the same remedies.
